note: Proposal only. Nothing here has been run. Seeds, budgets and thresholds become binding only after a separate registration approved by the user.

retention_test_RT1.purpose: Keep the verified Assault (襲撃) opening of the start model.
hands: Artmage-g11-p0 (g08-g11: known regression, results already seen)
retention_test_RT1.procedure: Isolated entry + common position adapter, free model, passive opponent, stop rules and goal check identical to check_other_positions.py (after mode); record functional items (board, resources, offered abilities) beside the legacy pass/fail.
retention_test_RT1.start_model_baseline: g08-g11 from this stage (4/4, identical to the original records); g06, g07 need 2 new runs.
retention_test_RT1.report: candidate vs start per hand; never pooled with battle results

new_condition_test_NT1.purpose: Does the free model play the two new openings?

fit_check.note: these hands are train data after conversion; success here is fit, not generalisation

hands_proposed.C1v: 襲撃 + 聖王の粉砕 (trap as the Maiden discard cost) + 幽鬼うさぎ + PSYフレームギア・γ + PSYフレーム・ドライバー
hands_proposed.C2v: 学都 + 三戦の才 (spell as the 学都 cost) + 幽鬼うさぎ + PSYフレームギア・γ + PSYフレーム・ドライバー

unseen_variants.rule: fixed before training, split-checked, never used for training; optional scripted feasibility run of each variant before training (2 runs)

measures: own-turn end: which of Maiden / Diaktoros / Litera / Fainmelt / Medius / 獄神使 are on the field, set S/T, active 学都 and 襲撃
resources: hand, graveyard, banished, extra face-up
opponent turn: abilities offered at player-0 windows (Maiden②, Litera③, 獄神使②, 覚醒, Fancy Ball②, Diaktoros② when its condition holds) and which were used
start of the next own turn: board and hand
normal summon usage is not scored; no single exact end board is required
new_condition_test_NT1.stop: first decision of turn 3, game over from env.step returns, or step cap

training_plan_TP1.seed: to be registered (checked against all past seeds)
training_plan_TP1.learning: PPO on Artmage self-play mirror (opponent = frozen start model) + rehearsal of demonstrations

rehearsal_data.new_demos: C1 (113 decisions, 94 proposed loss) and C2 (100 decisions, 85 proposed loss) after conversion
rehearsal_data.schedule_proposal: per 16 sequences: 12 old / 2 C1 / 2 C2 (fixed order, logged per source)
rehearsal_data.masks: context mask = all player-0 decisions; loss mask = own-turn decisions except select_position, plus C1's scripted opponent-turn steps

artmage_specific_changes: rollout backend for Artmage (deck key, recipe, random opening hands from the pinned deck, position adapter only; no Elfnotes center-placement adapter)
adapter-owned position prompts excluded from the policy loss, as in the Elfnotes backend
rehearsal module with DECK = 'Artmage' (the Elfnotes module hard-codes DECK = 'ElfnotesKewlTune' and Elfnotes case/label checks)
train base and chain head together; save both; reload through artmage_entry.create_policy(expected hashes); check logits equality on the saved C1/C2 observations before and after save/load
per-game RNN reset and separate player states; model inputs from public/own information only (check_observation on every step)
GPU jobs one at a time; resource limits 5 GiB / no swap / CPU 300% / 1,800 s
evaluation_after_training: Artmage mirror battles candidate vs start model per the reviewed paired-seat spec (scout 128 + reference 64; confirmation 256 only if stage 1 passes)
cross-deck battles vs fixed Elfnotes later, reported per opponent
training_plan_TP1.adoption: none without an explicit user decision; no gate defined in this draft
